residual_definition: Observed window median minus PSD-bin-averaged model, in dB.
spectral_spread_definition: Empirical 5th–95th window percentiles; not confidence intervals.
smoothing_definition: Exact ObsPy period mask over the FFT grid; average model dB values.
limitations: Depth and sensor band need independent validation.
Default 0.001–0.02 Hz band is a conservative workflow choice, not a universal validity limit.
No acceptance tolerance, pass/fail score or correction factor is inferred.
Existing 3-hour PPSD windows differ from the original 12.42-hour Hann-window and transient-screening procedure.
Model normalization fitted a different ocean region; local departures need interpretation.
Overlapping windows and frequency smoothing produce correlated samples.
